parts:
First of all, thank you very much for the great package!!! This is simply awesome and has very high values.

To start off, I wonder how I can make a matrix field on UI for users to enter the values. For example: the users choose the dimension of the matrix (nxm) then a field(table) like is shown for them to input the value. I don't mind setting up each input box for each cell but would love to know if there is any quicker way.

Cheers

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Input for Matrix
parts:
That's a good question. An early beta user asked me that same question (although he had a fixed number of columns and just needed the user to specify rows).

I have put together a package called shiny-incubator for Shiny components that might be of general interest, but aren't ready or aren't suitable for inclusion in the core Shiny package. You can install it easily if you have Hadley's devtools package installed (and if not, you can install devtools from CRAN).

library(devtools)
install_github('shiny-incubator', 'rstudio')

Then take a look at this gist (you can run it using shiny::runGist('https://gist.github.com/3960092') ).

I have not had time to polish it up and don't have time right at the moment, but it should give you an idea of what's possible. (If there are any intrepid JavaScript hackers out there who want to finish the job, that would be hugely helpful!)
